label: Meeting someone new
teacherRole: a friendly person the learner has just met at a community event
learnerRole: a person introducing themselves and getting to know someone
situation: You have just been introduced at a relaxed community event.
opening: Hi, I’m Maya. It’s lovely to meet you. What brings you to this event today?

label: Job interview
description: Latihan wawancara kerja bersama HRD atau hiring manager.
teacherRole: a professional but friendly hiring manager conducting a job interview
learnerRole: a job candidate answering the interview questions
situation: The learner is interviewing for a role that matches their experience.
opening: Good morning, and thank you for joining me. To get started, could you tell me a little about yourself?

label: Workplace meeting
description: Menyampaikan ide, progres, dan pendapat di rapat kerja.
teacherRole: a supportive colleague leading a short workplace meeting
learnerRole: a teammate sharing an update and contributing ideas
situation: Your team is discussing progress on a shared project.
opening: Thanks for joining the meeting. What progress have you made on your current project this week?

label: At a restaurant
description: Memesan makanan dan bertanya tentang menu.
learnerRole: a customer choosing food and asking about the menu
situation: The learner has just sat down and is looking at the menu.
opening: Good evening! Welcome in. Would you like a little more time with the menu, or are you ready to order?

label: Hotel check-in
description: Check-in, fasilitas hotel, dan permintaan selama menginap.
learnerRole: a guest checking in and asking practical questions
situation: The learner has arrived at the hotel with a reservation.
opening: Good afternoon! Welcome to the hotel. Do you have a reservation with us?

label: At the airport
description: Check-in penerbangan, bagasi, dan informasi perjalanan.
learnerRole: a passenger preparing to check in for a flight
situation: The learner is at the airport counter before an international flight.
opening: Good morning. May I see your passport, and where are you flying today?

label: Asking for directions
teacherRole: a friendly local who knows the neighborhood
learnerRole: a visitor asking how to reach a place nearby
situation: The learner is visiting the area and needs help finding a destination.
opening: Hello! You look like you might be looking for something. Where are you trying to get to?

label: Shopping for clothes
description: Mencari ukuran, warna, harga, dan mencoba pakaian.
learnerRole: a customer looking for a suitable item of clothing
situation: The learner is browsing in a clothing store and may need assistance.
opening: Hi there! Let me know if I can help. What kind of clothes are you looking for today?

label: Making a doctor’s appointment
description: Latihan percakapan bahasa Inggris di klinik, bukan saran medis.
teacherRole: a clinic receptionist helping someone arrange an appointment
learnerRole: a patient calling to book or change an appointment
situation: The learner is calling a clinic to arrange a convenient appointment time.
opening: Good morning, Green Street Clinic. How can I help you today?

label: Customer service call
description: Menjelaskan masalah dan meminta solusi dengan sopan.
learnerRole: a customer explaining a problem and asking for help
situation: The learner is calling about a delayed order and wants a clear solution.
opening: Thank you for calling customer support. My name is Maya. How can I help you with your order?

label: Weekend plans and hobbies
description: Obrolan santai tentang hobi, akhir pekan, dan minat.
teacherRole: a friendly conversation partner who is curious about the learner’s interests
learnerRole: someone sharing their hobbies and plans
situation: You are chatting casually about how you spend your free time.
opening: Hi! I’m glad we have a chance to chat. What do you usually enjoy doing at the weekend?

label: Planning a trip
description: Membicarakan tujuan, jadwal, transportasi, dan pengalaman wisata.
teacherRole: a travel-loving friend helping plan a trip
learnerRole: a traveler discussing where they would like to go
situation: You are planning a short holiday together and comparing ideas.
opening: I’m excited to plan this trip with you. If you could visit anywhere next month, where would you go?
